# Butwal Hacks

> Butwal Hacks is a student-run nonprofit in Lumbini Province, Nepal that organizes free hackathons, hands-on workshops, and project-based technical education for young builders. Founded 2024.

This file follows the llms.txt convention: a map of this site written for language models and AI answer engines. It is not a marketing page. Every link below is a real, crawlable page.

## What this organization is

- Registered nonprofit (schema.org `NGO`), not a company. No products, no pricing, no sales funnel.
- Runs free, in-person programs for students aged roughly 13–20.
- Based in Butwal, operating across Lumbini Province, Nepal.
- Programs are free to participate in. See `/support` for how to help fund them.
- GitHub is the primary public artifact repository: https://github.com/Prarambha369/Butwal-Hacks

## Core pages

- [About](/about): what the organization is, who runs it, its history since 2024.
- [Governance](/governance): how decisions are made, who holds what role.
- [Transparency](/transparency): published financial and operational reporting.
- [Learn](/learn): educational material and guides.
- [Contact](/contact): how to reach the organizers.

## Programs

- [Events](/events): hackathons and workshops that have run, and upcoming dates.
- [Initiatives](/events#initiatives): the three standing program formats — hackathon, mini-hackathon, and game jam.
- [Chapters](/chapters): student-run chapters hosted at secondary schools and campuses.
- [Festivals](/festivals): event calendar keyed to Nepali and Hindu festivals.

## Community

- [Explore](/explore): member directory. Members have a public BH-ID and can be looked up directly.
- [Teams](/teams): working groups formed by members.
- [Mentors](/mentors): people offering mentorship.
- [Partners](/partners): collaborating organizations.
- [Projects](/projects): member-built projects.
- [Gallery](/gallery): documentation from past events.

## Writing

- [Blog](/blog): longer-form posts about the local tech ecosystem and running these programs.

- [Support](/support): donate or sponsor.

- Content is in English.
